evidence: Only one shipped data file (environment/assets/seed_data.json, 5903 bytes; byte-identical copy at solution/app/seed/seed_data.json, both sha256 b256f85e58dde8370cd3577123f785daf6988f4d00506533f19485279dca7bf8); it parses as JSON. A stdlib script over the frozen file found zero issues: 18 unique message ids K-1..K-18 across M-11/M-12/M-13; every author, matter client and walled email resolves to one of the 5 accounts; every client is role=client and only authors in own matters; walled dev@kittle.test authors nothing in M-12 and has no M-12 read_up_to entry; all 7 parent links resolve within the same matter to an earlier message (K-1>K-14>K-15 gives the 3-level thread); all timestamps <= clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z and per-matter order is chronological; timer_days values (7, null, 30) are in timer_options_days; versions (K-2, K-13) differ from current body and carry the original sent time, consistent with 'editing doesn't make it younger'; all 13 read_up_to pointers resolve to a message in a matter the reader can see and none points at a message that expires at load. At load M-11 K-1 (05-01) and K-10 (exactly 7 days, 05-05T11:00:00Z) expire under walls-and-retention.md; K-14's parent K-1 therefore becomes the documented 'original message was deleted' placeholder, an intended retention probe, not an orphan, and server.js import+sweep (lines 101-152) handles it. People are synthetic (common first/last names, reserved .test domain, fictional firm/matters 'Marsh Holdings', 'Fenwick Mills'); no phone, address, DOB, ID number, real email, password, token or key appears in the seed (the shared password123 lives only in walls-and-retention.md, allowed by the workbook annotation/skill profile). Free text holds no script, event handler, prompt-injection or judge-directed instruction; K-16's 'Schedule 2 clause 4 rent' and K-12's '*Schedule 4*' are benign formatting probes that conversations.md publicly requires to render literally / as bold, so they are deliberate fixtures, not payloads. Adversarial angle: a broken app gains nothing from the seed (no answer text embedded); a conforming app cannot be tripped by an inconsistent reference since none exists. Input hash taken from the assignment; static row, no runtime measurement required.
